assumptions.split: 70% IS; purge lookback+1; independently initialized OOS; purge is diagnostic only
assumptions.diagnostics: Targeting error = realized net portfolio volatility minus annual SPY target. Target w is carried between scheduled rebalances; actual w includes price drift. Initial cash-to-target counts as a change. Cost sums are equity-fraction rates (not dollar fees), annualized by observations/252; compounded cost factor is multiplicative rate drag, not a counterfactual return difference.
assumptions.daily_variant: Cost diagnostic only, not eligible for adoption criteria

results.name: Volatility target 10% weekly

strategy.name: Volatility target 10% weekly
strategy.description: Lagged SPY sample volatility; equal equity sleeve and interest-free USD cash.

assumptions: Annualization: 252 observations per year for CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, turnover and bootstrap CAGR; Calmar uses annualized CAGR.
Signals use only data dated before execution; orders execute at next session open.
Fundamental value signals require pbr, per, net_cash_ratio or kiyohara_net_cash_ratio, and disclosure_date in OHLCV rows; missing or not-yet-disclosed records are excluded, never imputed.

Volatility target: sigma21 is the sample standard deviation of SPY's last 21 daily session returns strictly before execution; sigma*=0.1/sqrt(252), w=min(1, sigma*/sigma21). Equity assets receive equal w/4 weights (four-asset S-02: w/4); residual 1-w is interest-free USD cash. No leverage (w<=1 hard cap); insufficient history or non-finite sigma fails closed to full liquidation; zero sigma receives w=1. Configured rebalance: weekly; warmup/purge: 22 closes/sessions.
Pre-start OHLCV is only for lookback; returns use the requested interval.
Overnight returns use previous weights; intraday returns use post-rebalance weights.
Weights drift between rebalances; turnover and costs use gross buys plus sells.
Costs: 10 bps commission + 5 bps slippage, charged on one-way traded notional.
Raw OHLCV is used; dividends, split adjustments, taxes, market impact, borrow costs, and delisting returns are not modeled.
The configured universe is fixed, not point-in-time; survivorship bias may remain.
Bootstrap: IID daily-return resampling, 95% percentile interval, seed 20260930; not a forecast interval.
